notes.title: New Content Update Soon!
notes.content: [h1]Version 0.5.0![/h1][p][/p][h3]FLOODED FORTRESS (Level 8)[/h3][list][*][p]A new enemy is being added to Flooded Fortress[/p][/*][*][p]Changed how a song variant of Flooded Fortress is triggered[/p][/*][*][p]Added some new content to Flooded Fortress[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]CONTENT[/h3][list][*][p]Small content additions throughout the game[/p][/*][*][p]Small aesthetic changes or additions throughout the game[/p][/*][*][p]Small rebalances to challenges throughout the game[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]BUG FIXES[/h3][list][*][p]Removed the ledge grab/water entrance collision glitch that got a lot of people stuck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some collision bugs throughout the game, specifically a consistent collision bug in Calcium Catacombs (Level 7)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some framerate issues throughout the gams[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some grammar and spelling[/p][/*][*][p]Other miscellaneous fixes[/p][p][/p][h3]Thank you to all the new players who got the game this week![/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45445796/db1e86470db92dd1b47e7fcccf68703212e53a84.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list]
